custom_pages.title: Privacy Policy
custom_pages.content:
Last updated: 1 October 2026

1. Information we collect
We collect the details you give us when your tenancy or account is set up: your name, email address, phone number, identity details and address, plus records of invoices, payments, agreements and maintenance requests.

2. How we use your information
We use it to manage your tenancy, issue invoices and receipts, arrange maintenance, contact you about your account and meet our legal obligations.

3. Sharing
We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with contractors who carry out maintenance on our behalf, payment providers, and authorities when the law requires it.

4. Security and retention
Accounts are protected by passwords and access is limited by role. We keep records for as long as your tenancy lasts and afterwards for as long as the law requires.

5. Your rights
Under the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 you may ask to access or correct your personal data. Contact the management office to do so.

custom_pages.title: Terms & Conditions
custom_pages.content:
Last updated: 1 October 2026

1. Accounts
The management office creates every account. Keep your login details private; you are responsible for activity on your account.

2. Payments
Invoices must be paid by their due date. Late payments may incur the late fee stated in your tenancy agreement. Bank receipts you upload are checked before the payment is recorded.

3. Maintenance requests
Report issues promptly with an accurate description. Urgent issues that put people or property at risk should also be reported by phone.

4. Acceptable use
Do not misuse the portal, upload unlawful content or try to access other users' information.

5. Changes
We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the portal means you accept the updated terms.
